message.content:
Here’s a mix of classic, modern, psychological, supernatural, and slasher horror films that have earned a reputation for being genuinely scary or unsettling. Feel free to pick based on your taste!

| Sub‑Genre | Title (Year) | Why It’s Worth Watching |
|-----------|--------------|------------------------|
| **Classic Gothic** | *Psycho* (1960) | Hitchcock’s masterclass in suspense and the iconic shower scene. |
| | *The Shining* (1980) | Stanley Kubrick’s atmospheric dread and Jack Nicholson’s chilling performance. |
| **Psychological Thriller** | *Se7en* (1995) | A grim, noir‑style investigation into a serial killer’s seven deadly sins. |
| | *Memento* (2000) | A mind‑bending narrative that keeps you guessing. |
| **Supernatural** | *The Exorcist* (1973) | One of the most terrifying depictions of demonic possession ever made. |
| | *Hereditary* (2018) | A modern take on family trauma and occult horror. |
| **Slasher** | *Halloween* (1978) | The original Michael Myers film that set the template for slasher movies. |
| | *Scream* (1996) | A self‑aware, meta‑take on the slasher genre that revitalized it. |
| **Body Horror** | *The Fly* (1986) | David Cronenberg’s visceral depiction of mutation and loss of identity. |
| | *Annihilation* (2018) | A surreal, sci‑fi horror that explores the unknown. |
| **Found Footage** | *The Blair Witch Project* (1999) | A low‑budget film that created a new sub‑genre of horror. |
| | *Paranormal Activity* (2007) | A modern found‑footage film that re‑ignited interest in the format. |
| **Monster Horror** | *Jaws* (1975) | Steven Spielberg’s thriller that turned a great white shark into a terrifying icon. |
| | *The Thing* (1982) | A tense, claustrophobic story about an alien parasite that can mimic anyone. |
| **Horror Comedy** | *Shaun of the Dead* (2004) | A hilarious take on zombie apocalypse tropes. |
| | *Tucker & Dale vs. Evil* (2010) | A clever twist on the “camp horror” trope. |

### How to Choose:
- **If you’re into classic suspense:** Go for *Psycho* or *The Shining*.
- **If you prefer modern psychological thrills:** Try *Hereditary* or *Memento*.
- **If you love supernatural chills:** Watch *The Exorcist* or *Hereditary*.
- **If you enjoy slasher gore:** Check out *Halloween* or *Scream*.
- **If you’re into body horror:** *The Fly* or *Annihilation* will satisfy you.
- **If you want a fresh take on found footage:** *The Blair Witch Project* or *Paranormal Activity*.
- **If you’re looking for monster terror:** *Jaws* or *The Thing*.
- **If you want a laugh with your scares:** *Shaun of the Dead* or *Tucker & Dale vs. Evil*.

Happy watching—just make sure you have a good night‑time snack and a comfy seat!
